summary_1line: Krishna enters the chamber where Abhimanyu’s stillborn son lies as Uttara and the women of the Pandavas lament and plead for the child’s revival.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna steps into the sanctified birth chamber filled with white garlands, water pots, fires, and protective charms as grieving women look on.
Uttara collapses to the floor clutching her lifeless newborn while Kunti and the royal women weep around her in the palace.
The distraught Uttara lifts her dead child in her lap and pleads before Krishna, tears streaming as the palace echoes with lamentation.
